shorts.title: What you will learn: Iterators
shorts.hook: One way to walk any container.
shorts.script: One way to walk any container. Today we learn the idea behind every loop in the library. An iterator is like a pointer for a container. An iterator points at one item in a container. Star reads the item. Plus plus moves to the next one. Begin points at the first item. End points one past the last item. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Iterators.

shorts.title: Iterators in one minute
shorts.hook: An iterator points at one item in a container.
shorts.script: An iterator points at one item in a container. Star reads the item. Plus plus moves to the next one. Begin points at the first item. End points one past the last item. You stop when you reach end. The same code works for vector, list, set and map. Think of a finger on a train timetable. It points at one line, and moves to the next. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Iterators in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: A list is not an array.
shorts.script: A list is not an array. You cannot write begin plus two. Next moves an iterator forward by a number of steps. It works for every container. The item is fifteen. Distance counts the steps between two iterators. The answer is two. The program prints fifteen, and then two. An iterator points at one item. Star reads, and plus plus moves on. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Erasing and skipping
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in iterators?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in iterators? Bug of the Day. We erase all even numbers, but four stays in the vector. Erase already returns the next item. Then the loop moves on again, and skips it. Move the iterator only when you did not erase. Erase returns the iterator of the next item. The loop then moves on again, and skips that item. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Erasing and skipping.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you remove all negative numbers in iterators?
shorts.script: Can you remove all negative numbers in iterators? Why did the iterator never get lost? It always knew where end was. Write a loop with iterators that removes all negative numbers from a vector. Do not skip any item. Write your answer in the comments. An iterator points at one item. Star reads, and plus plus moves on. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
